TABLE.NAME: block_curriculummap_link
TABLE.COMMENT: CSV-sourced course-to-item links, used when an axis's datasource setting is 'csv' instead of 'competency'. Overwritten wholesale per axis on each new CSV upload (see classes/form/csv_confirm_form.php).

FIELD.NAME: instanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Block instance this row belongs to; null = site-wide shared default data.

FIELD.NAME: courseidnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical subject identity for CSV-sourced data; does not require a matching Moodle course to exist.

FIELD.NAME: coursename
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional CSV-provided display name, used only when courseid is null (no matching course found).

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Resolved Moodle course id if courseidnumber matched an existing course; null otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: parentlabel
FIELD.COMMENT: Descriptive grouping label only (e.g. major category); not a foreign key.
